slides.texte_overlay:
Things that age a man badly
(and how to avoid them)
Never moving his body. Stiffness, back pain and low energy come quickly without exercise. Thirty minutes of movement a day keeps you young far longer than any cream.
Bad sleep, year after year. Short nights show in your face, your mood and your health. Protect seven to eight hours like it's part of your job, because it is.
Stopping learning. Men who stop being curious start sounding old long before their age. Read, travel and try new things to keep your mind young.
Holding on to bitterness. Old grudges and constant complaining age you inside and out. Letting go keeps you lighter and much easier to be around.
Before: I felt my mind getting lazy. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and I feel more curious now than I did years ago.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I felt my mind getting lazy. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. I feel more curious now than I did years ago.

slides.texte_overlay: Ignoring his skin. Sunscreen, water and a simple moisturiser. Ten seconds a day prevents damage you'll really notice in ten years.
Losing his friends. Men who stay social stay sharper and happier. Keep calling, keep meeting up, keep making new friends at every age.
